examples.title: Quick start

sections.title: Types
rows: Immutable record bundling `Type`, `DayFlags`, `MonthFlags`, set-times, interval bounds, one-shot timestamp, and `CronExpression`. `Validate()` throws when fields don't match the chosen `ScheduleType`.

Fluent builder — `SetTimes(...)`, `Interval(...)`, `OneShot(...)`, `SetCron(string)`, `OnDays(DayOfWeek)`, `InMonths(...)`. Calling a `Set*` mutator switches `Type` so callers can't combine inconsistent fields.
